newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR SELLS SVENSKA FODER STAKE.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR SELLS SVENSKA FODER STAKE.

text.p: Finnish food and enzymes group Cultor Oy said on Wednesday it had executed the planned sale of its 54.3 percent holding in Svenska Foder AB for 106 million markka to Danish company KFK .

"The book value of the Cultor 54.3 percent holding in the group's consolidated balance sheet is 119 million markka. Therefore, the group will book a one-time write-off of 13 million markka on the transaction," Cultor said in a statement.
"The purchase price of Svenska Foder is approximately 22 times the net profit, using the average of Svenska Foder's 1996 (estimate) and 1995 net profits," it said.
The transaction, the terms of which were set in the letter of intent on September 24, was closed on November 29, Cultor said.

Cultor said the divestment of Svenska Foder to Korn- og Foderstof Kompagniet A/S (KFK) will create a new agribusiness structure covering both Denmark and the southern part of Sweden and therefore improving the overall competitiveness of the industry.
"For Cultor this is a further step to focus on high value added and technology intensive business activities supported by strong cash generators," Cultor said.
